comparison.objective: Set and lock a rigid gripper mechanism versus cut six stitches while preserving flexible fabric.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires two-tool countertorque and articulated verification; the seam task requires precise blade placement and selective cutting without fabric damage.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades angle, locking, nut retention, cycles, and clearance; the seam task counts visibly separated stitches and invalidates all credit for cuts or tears.
comparison.reason: Selective cutting of deformable material is unrelated to screw-and-jam-nut adjustment and retained mechanical calibration.
